gap.title: At fan-in two, one NOT gate saves nothing on edges 0-4 1-5 0-6 2-6 0-7 1-7 2-7 3-7 5-7
gap.statement: ∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (o : ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∀ i j : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → (gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → i = j) → (∀ x : Fin 8 → Bool, PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, o⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ i < ([0, 4, 1, 5, 0, 6, 2, 6, 0, 7, 1, 7, 2, 7, 3, 7, 5, 7] : List ℕ).length / 2, (List.ofFn x).getD (([0, 4, 1, 5, 0, 6, 2, 6, 0, 7, 1, 7, 2, 7, 3, 7, 5, 7] : List ℕ).getD (2 * i) 0) false = true ∧ (List.ofFn x).getD (([0, 4, 1, 5, 0, 6, 2, 6, 0, 7, 1, 7, 2, 7, 3, 7, 5, 7] : List ℕ).getD (2 * i + 1) 0) false = true)) → ∃ (gates' : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (o' : ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates', (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ gates'.length ≤ gates.length ∧ ∀ x : Fin 8 → Bool, PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates', o'⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ i < ([0, 4, 1, 5, 0, 6, 2, 6, 0, 7, 1, 7, 2, 7, 3, 7, 5, 7] : List ℕ).length / 2, (List.ofFn x).getD (([0, 4, 1, 5, 0, 6, 2, 6, 0, 7, 1, 7, 2, 7, 3, 7, 5, 7] : List ℕ).getD (2 * i) 0) false = true ∧ (List.ofFn x).getD (([0, 4, 1, 5, 0, 6, 2, 6, 0, 7, 1, 7, 2, 7, 3, 7, 5, 7] : List ℕ).getD (2 * i + 1) 0) false = true)
gap.unlocks: Direction 4 (one NOT gate): the smallest graphs on which one NOT gate saves a gate, if any
gap.sketch: For an eight-vertex graph with a 4-cycle: show every AND/OR/NOT list (at most two inputs each, at most one NOT gate) for its edge function can be replaced by an AND/OR list no longer, or refute it with a one-NOT list shorter than every AND/OR list. Known: the replacement side was checked on 499 seven-vertex and eight six-vertex graphs. Here our NOT-gate lower bound and best AND/OR circuit differ by 1 to 21 gates, so the truth is not known. Route: exhaustive search on eight inputs with a certificate. Size: minutes to hours of solver time per graph.
